title: Booker and the Budweiser job
summary: Handy recalls an old musician Booker who lent him notes, and playing bass at Budweiser; an aside about a killing there.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I think of his name before you leave. But right now, I can't. We work at Budweiser together. I played bass violin at Budweiser for years and years. And I can't think of his name. Booker. Booker.

You don't recall Booker? He was an old time musician. And he'd been in the local for years. He was working. No, he wasn't working at the time of Gagli killed the... That man killed Gagli. Walter Decker. Yeah, he wasn't working. He wasn't working there then. Mm-hmm. They had laid the bass off. Because this thing got bad and he wasn't working there. But he was the whole bass player there at the Budweiser at that time. But anyway...
